She wears a cream off-white ribbed knit sweater with a wide fold-over collar and secure coverage, faded vintage-blue denim jeans, and carries a canvas tote with navy straps. She stands with her torso slightly tilted forward and holds her smartphone with both hands near her chest while looking down at it.

A blurred foreground phone or passenger obstruction may frame the lower-left corner, but its screen must remain blank or abstract and unreadable.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even cool-toned fluorescent tubes line the train ceiling, creating realistic soft highlights on the face, neck, and sweater with mixed-color-temperature transit shadows. Preserve mobile sensor noise, slight grain, accidental imperfections, crowded-but-socially-isolated urban commute energy, and Tokyo slice-of-life atmosphere.
